text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I did it...! Among such tough 
rivals from my generation! And...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I could hear so much cheering... Espo-san, 
Falcon-san, and not just them...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Furioso! The regionals didn't 
lose out one bit!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
There are people cheering on our 
challenge, too...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Everyone. I am truly happy to have 
achieved such a great result today.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for cheering for me in 
the rain!

Overcoming all kinds of adverse 
conditions, Furioso delivered a solid, 
impressive performance.

Back at the training lodge—the evening of 
the following day.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please look. At the sky.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Does the color of this... evening sky 
remind you of anything?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"We were painfully reminded that day. 
Reminded of our own powerlessness. And—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Just how lacking they are in the will to 
break free from being weaklings.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To overturn that—that is why we came all 
this way.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Studying abroad in the Central, overcoming 
the Japan Dirt Derby— and finally, making 
it all the way here.

What Furioso wanted to do moving forward— 
I already had a pretty good idea of what 
that was.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to challenge them. The one 
who trampled Funabashi with overwhelming 
power that day...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: To Crimson Nova!

"Crimson Nova. She's one of the strongest 
dirt Umamusume in the JRA."

She already has 5 graded race wins under 
her belt, including 1 GⅠ. What's more, 
she's an ace who continues to grow 
stronger, like a rising dragon.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Unless I fight her, nothing will ever be 
fulfilled. Nothing will begin. Nothing 
will be regained.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Of course, they will be tremendously 
strong. Even so, however—
choice_data_list: So you're taking it on, right?
So you're going to take on the challenge?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

Unwavering eyes. Furioso and my real 
challenge in the JRA finally begins here. 
First off—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: The JBC Classic?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, the one most likely to enter the 
race is...
Yeah, the one most likely to enter is...

text_block_list.text:
"The JBC Classic. It's a 2,000m GⅠ held at 
Oi Racecourse in November."

"If Crimson Nova is aiming for a race, 
this seems like the most likely one."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Understood. The JBC Classic... It's 
finally time.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Channel that frustration from back then 
into running— Now is the time to unleash 
it!

That "Bloody Diolite Kinen" is trauma for 
the two of us— no, for all of Funabashi.

Let's clear away this crimson nightmare, 
even just a little. Starting with the JBC 
Classic.
